question: Who among the following received the Padma Shri 2021 in the field of Art for his/her contribution to Indian dance?
solution:
The correct answer is **Radhe Shyam Barle**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Radhe Shyam Barle** received the Padma Shri award in 2021 for his contributions to Indian dance.
 
• The Padma Shri is the fourth highest civilian award in India.
 
• It is awarded to individuals for their distinguished contributions in various fields, including art, literature, science, and public service.
 
• Radhe Shyam Barle is renowned for his work in promoting traditional Indian dance forms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Award
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Padma Shri**
 The **Padma Shri** is awarded for distinguished service in various fields such as art, literature, science, and public service.
 
 

 **Padma Bhushan**
 The **Padma Bhushan** is the third highest civilian award in India, given for distinguished service of a high order.
 
 

 **Padma Vibhushan**
 The **Padma Vibhushan** is the second highest civilian award in India, awarded for exceptional and distinguished service.
 
 

 **Bharat Ratna**
 The **Bharat Ratna** is the highest civilian award in India, awarded for exceptional service towards the advancement of art, literature, and science, and in recognition of public service of the highest order.
